quick.t: Can you speak more slowly, please?
quick.ca: Pot parlar més a poc a poc, si us plau?
Ho pot repetir, si us plau?

quick.t: Can you write it down, please?
quick.ca: Ho pot escriure, si us plau?

quick.t: How do you say this in English?
quick.ca: Com es diu això en anglès?

quick.t: Please wait a moment. I am writing my answer.
quick.ca: Esperi un moment, si us plau. Estic escrivint la meva resposta.
Em pot ajudar, si us plau?
Si us plau, truqui a aquest número.

quick.t: That is not what I mean.

quick.ca: Una altra vegada, si us plau.
